peers.name: Alphabet Inc.
peers.rationale: Direct overlap in cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud vs Azure), enterprise software, and AI investment; differs in ad-driven revenue mix, but comparable scale and platform economics.

peers.name: AMAZON COM INC
peers.rationale: AWS competes directly with Azure in cloud infrastructure; Amazon's retail segment is not comparable, so multiple reflects a blended, partly overlapping business.

peers.name: ORACLE CORP
peers.rationale: Enterprise software and cloud infrastructure competitor with overlapping database, ERP, and cloud migration customers, though smaller scale and more concentrated in enterprise apps.

peers.name: Salesforce, Inc.
peers.rationale: Enterprise SaaS competitor overlapping in CRM, productivity, and AI-enabled business software; smaller and more narrowly focused than Microsoft's diversified portfolio.

peers.name: SAP SE
peers.rationale: Global enterprise software leader competing in ERP and cloud business applications, similar large-enterprise customer base though less diversified into consumer/OS/gaming.

peers.name: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MACHINES CORP
peers.rationale: Overlaps in enterprise IT services, hybrid cloud, and AI software; IBM's legacy hardware/consulting mix makes the comparison partial.

peers.name: ADOBE INC.
peers.rationale: Comparable high-margin software subscription model and enterprise/creative software overlap, though far smaller scale and no cloud infrastructure business.

peers.name: Apple Inc.
peers.rationale: Comparable as a mega-cap technology platform with software/services growth focus, though core hardware-driven revenue model differs substantially from Microsoft's.
